item.title: BPD-CHP operation on Union Avenue nets 188 citations
item.description: An eight-hour traffic enforcement operation focused on Union Avenue resulted in 188 citations and eight vehicle impounds Wednesday, the Bakersfield Police Department reported.

item.title: Grossman Burn Center set to close June 30
item.description: The Grossman Burn Center will close June 30 following consistently low patient volumes, according to its host Bakersfield Memorial Hospital.

item.title: Scrivner appears in court as bills look to reform mental health program
item.description: Former Kern County Supervisor Zack Scrivner appeared briefly in court Thursday, even as lawmakers have recently introduced legislation aimed at reforming the mental health diversion program.

item.title: German shepherd left in stolen vehicle still missing
item.description: A vehicle-and-trailer theft Wednesday evening in west Bakersfield has caused collateral damage in the form of a German shepherd who remains missing.

item.title: Veteran 190-pounders, Highland's Alvarado, Centennial's Oragwam battle through at State
item.description: With a combined five medals, Briana Alvarado and Onyi Oragwam have achieved plenty of success at the CIF State Girls Wrestling Championships the past three years at Mechanics Bank Arena.

item.description: It’ll be three girls basketball teams that will take center stage in terms of local teams playing in their respective CIF Central Section division championships games today and Saturday at Fresno’s Selland Arena.
